title: The photo of the dog
logline: A photo of a dog the shop framed in 2008 — not his dog; a customer's — on a mantel in 2024 with a collar hung on its corner. The dog gone; the frame keeping the collar. The page drew this once for its own and draws it now for a stranger.

panels.composition: A framed photo of a dog on a mantel with a leather collar hung over the frame's corner, a clock beside it, afternoon light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a framed photo of a dog on a mantel with a leather collar hung over the frame's corner, a clock beside it, afternoon light, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
